name: obsidian-zotero-vault-bridge
description: Keep PDFs in an Obsidian vault while Zotero 10 recognizes and manages their bibliographic metadata.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @zvb/obsidian-plugin && npm run build --workspace @zvb/zotero-companion
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @zvb/obsidian-plugin && npm run test --workspace @zvb/zotero-companion
